name: portfolio-sheet
description: One 842x599 sheet of a portfolio document, drawn to Figma's 'Design template' section: main (title, year, one picture), work, detail (portrait picture, caption at its side), multi (2x2), exhibition (wide photo), text and more-text (one 300px column). The same markup is the dashboard preview and, later, the PDF page.

props.name: layout
props.description: Which Figma sheet to draw: main, work, detail, multi, exhibition, text, more-text, or missing (the project behind the entry is gone).

props.name: title
props.description: main only: the project name, Bodoni Moda Bold 28.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: main only: the line under the title (year).

props.name: images
props.description: Pictures as {src, alt, prefix, label, suffix, lines}. One for main, work and exhibition, four for multi. The caption block is built from the first one: prefix + label (medium weight) + suffix, then one line each.

props.name: paragraphs
props.description: text and more-text: the paragraphs of the column.

props.name: page
props.description: The number printed bottom left as 'page N'.

rationale: Read off the Figma section 'Design template' (node 328:19053, one frame per layout, all 842x599). Every offset is the Figma value as a multiple of one 842nd of the sheet's width (--u, a container-query unit), so the sheet is the identical drawing in a 400px pane and at 842px in print, and the preview can never drift from the exported page. Paper is white with black text in both themes: it is a document, and print must not depend on the app theme. Pictures are never cropped (object-fit: contain, maintainer 2026-10-11), the exhibition photo included, so portrait and landscape pictures of any proportion fit a slot; the host chooses work, detail, multi or exhibition from the picture's proportions. In detail (328:18918) the picture sits against its caption and the page number stays black, since Figma's white number assumes a full-bleed picture. Type is Bodoni Moda Bold for the title and Karla Light / Medium for text and captions, as in Figma; neither is a dis-system token yet, so the stacks live in this component with local() @font-face and fall back to a system serif / sans-serif until the files are self-hosted. The multi sheet's empty-cell fill is Figma's raw #3E3F36, which has no variable: base-800 is used.
a11y_notes: Pictures are decorative (empty alt) because the caption beside each one names it; pass a real alt where there is no caption. The title is an h3 so a sheet stack reads as a list of sections. Text is black on white, 14px / 12px Karla Light: contrast is full, size is small by design of the Figma sheet.
